Changes made for Yunqi, 2026-11-07:
- Extracted the head and hair meshes; removed original clothing and the rest of the body.
- Converted the geometry to a head-local attachment for Yunqi's animation rig.
- Retained authored face textures, eye/mouth geometry, UVs, blink and smile morphs.
- Changed hair colour and rendering materials at runtime.
- Combined with Yunqi's separately authored/adapted Chinese garments, ornaments,
  straight sword and animation system. The VRM license covers the extracted asset,
  and does not change the separate licenses of the surrounding project.

Rebuild: node tools/build-heroine-head.mjs /path/to/VRM1_Constraint_Twist_Sample.vrm

The original license and permission metadata are also retained inside qingheng-head.glb.
This is an adapted candidate character, not a reconstruction of the user's reference.
